scope: Ten primary publications compared against fourteen selected conceptual claims in six execution-identity, processor-mode and task/startup-permission explanations. The named sections were read from publisher documents, and their responses were retrieved by GET for this pass. This comparison excludes commands, tools, prerequisites, applicability, connection outcomes, operational route viability and ATT&CK mappings. Navigation labels remain project conventions. Exact claims, source sections, reviewer type, date and content snapshots are stored with the entries.
